HOME.ABOUT_TEXT_1: Raizen Hostel was born from the desire to create a conscious refuge in Dosquebradas, Risaralda. A place where every detail — the light, the silence, the aroma of coffee — invites you to escape the noise of the world.
HOME.ABOUT_TEXT_2: Whether you come to rest, explore the Coffee Axis, or simply pause for a moment, here you will find a temporary home that takes care of you.
HOME.AVAILABILITY_SUBTITLE: Book easily and safely with Wompi — card, PSE or Nequi.

FOOTER.DESC: Familiar and conscious hostel in Dosquebradas, Risaralda. A space to rest, connect, and feel at home.

HABITACIONES.DESC_HERO: Choose between our private rooms or beds in a shared dormitory. All with WiFi, bed linen, and access to common areas.
HABITACIONES.DESC_PRIVADAS: 5 rooms with own key, peaceful environment, and personalized attention.
HABITACIONES.DESC_DORMITORIO: 10 single beds on a common floor. Ideal for solo travelers or groups.
HABITACIONES.WARNING_DESC: Hostel for adults only. No children or pets allowed. If you arrive with minors or pets, you will not be admitted and will forfeit the full reservation amount.
HABITACIONES.INFO_LIST: Homemade breakfast · High-speed WiFi · Hotel insurance · Access to common areas · Complimentary towel · Check-in 3:00 PM · Check-out 12:00 PM.
